summary: Backend fully validated: 20/20 pytest tests passing including auth, dashboard, all seeded lists (horses, medications, vet-records, injuries, wellness, lessons, training, invoices, messages, owners, riders), feed-task completion, invoice pay, service-request create+approve, message create, and AI generate (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend login page renders beautifully with luxury aesthetic and demo accounts visible. However, clicking the 'Enter the barn' submit button did NOT navigate away from /login — body text remained on the SIGN IN landing after click+3s wait, blocking all downstream UI testing (Horses, Barn Board, Billing).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Enter the barn' submit button does not navigate to dashboard; URL remains /login. Backend /api/auth/login works (confirmed via pytest). Likely a frontend handler / form submit bug, or button is not type=submit and onClick not wired. Possibly missing data-testid on email/password/submit which made selectors ambiguous, but the visible button was clicked. Recommend adding data-testid='login-email', 'login-password', 'login-submit' and verifying onSubmit handler calls AuthContext.login and navigates.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reach protected routes due to login submit not working; Horses / Barn Board / Billing flows untested in UI.

action_items: Investigate why clicking the 'Enter the barn' button on /login does not submit the form / call AuthContext.login. Check console for errors, verify form onSubmit vs button onClick, ensure JWT is stored to localStorage 'equine_token' and navigate('/') is called.
Add data-testid attributes to login email input, password input, and submit button (and to sidebar nav items, horse cards, pay buttons) to enable robust automated testing.
After login fix, manually verify Dashboard, Barn Board, Horses list+profile tabs, Billing pay flow, Owner Portal service-request form.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-seed only runs when users collection is empty — good. POST /api/seed however wipes all data without auth — should require admin token in production.
AI endpoint has 90s timeout potential; consider adding request-level timeout in client.
No password length / strength validation in /auth/register.
Missing data-testid attributes broadly across frontend reduces testability.
test_credentials: Already present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@equinesync.com / demo1234 + 4 other demo accounts).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 horses, 3 owners, 3 riders, feed tasks (today), medications, vet records, injuries, wellness, lessons, training, invoices, messages, service requests, and incidents on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock-solid (20/20 tests pass) — focus next iteration on frontend login submit handler in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.* and AuthContext.jsx. Once login works, regression test Dashboard, Barn Board, Horses, Billing pay, Owner Portal service-request, and AI owner-update buttons.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend login submit click did not result in navigation. Selector clicked the visible 'Enter the barn' button but URL stayed /login and dashboard text was absent. Either the click resolved to wrong element, the form is using onSubmit on <form> rather than onClick (and our locator clicked a button outside the form), or AuthContext.login is throwing silently. Main agent should inspect Login.jsx form structure and ensure submit button is type='submit' inside the form, or attach explicit onClick that awaits login() and then navigate('/').
